experiments.design: 50,000 authoritative events over 200 keys; derived stream receives injected duplicates, local reordering and loss of the final 3% tail.
experiments.inference: A canonical authoritative log plus replay/idempotent derivation can restore constructed state after duplicate/reorder/loss faults; direct derived-stream state cannot.
experiments.boundary: Synthetic mechanism test; not live FRANK or production storage evidence.

experiments.design: 200,000 operations over 12 consistency domains; 8% of episodes hide one true dependency from the observed scoped closure.
experiments.inference: Operation-scoped revalidation is only safe when closure knowledge is sound. Unknown/hidden dependency state must trigger conservative broadening/escalation; otherwise the constructed test admits unsafe accepts.
experiments.boundary: Zero unsafe accepts applies only to the constructed broadening policy/test family; it is not a production safety proof.

experiments.design: 100,000 constructed candidate-selection cases across SET, ORDERED, MULTISET and WEIGHTED semantics; compare correct semantics with a type-erased alternative.
experiments.inference: Collection semantics can be a downstream causal dependency because type erasure changes candidate topology while item identities remain authentic. ORDERED was especially sensitive in this construction.
experiments.boundary: Constructed candidate model, not a database or live GWT effect-size benchmark.

experiments.inference: No new model-behavior conclusion is drawn from this experiment in G12.

negative_results: Scoped consistency without uncertainty broadening is unsafe under hidden dependencies in the constructed E2B family.
Collection type erasure can substantially change candidate topology despite unchanged authentic item identities.
A queued model experiment without a returned result is not evidence.
